dedupe_keys.name: madrid public schools and municipal facilities and entities directory

description: Dirección General de Atención a la Ciudadanía, Madrid City Council publishes two directories compiled from the municipal web madrid.es: the public schools of the city and the municipal and non-municipal facilities and entities published there, each entry giving (where available) opening hours, equipment and services, the full address with district, neighbourhood, postcode and coordinates, nearest public transport (bus, metro, BiciMAD, Renfe), telephone, e-mail and web address. Coverage: the city of Madrid; both datasets are listed as updated daily and were modified on 2026-09-28. Format and access: CSV, JSON, XML, RDF, PDF, geo (as labelled on the portal), downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the pages say the information may not be exhaustive because it is what is currently published on madrid.es and that non-municipal entries reflect what the web managers know; the files were not opened; the record is anchored to the schools page with the facilities page linked. Simulation uses: schools and municipal facilities as shelters, critical facilities and service points in flood, heat and evacuation models, and for accessibility and coverage analysis. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
